stories.title: CPSC Warning — FZChenrry Magnetic Fidget Ball Toys, No Recall, No Refund, Dispose Now

x_posts.label: Post 2-1
x_posts.text: ⚠️ No recall, no refund — CPSC says dispose now. FZChenrry magnetic fidget balls (purple silicone, black case) sold Amazon 2025–2026. High-powered magnets can be fatal if swallowed. CPSC Warning #27-095. #COSParenting #ColoradoSprings #COSKids #PikesPeakParenting

x_posts.text:
FZChenrry magnetic fidget balls: seller refused the recall. If you bought these on Amazon Feb 2025–Sep 2026 — do not use, do not give away. Dispose now. No refund available. CPSC Warning #27-095.

stories.title: Colorado Springs Childcare Desert — 47,000 Kids, 18,400 Spots, City Passes New Zoning Law
